'''Luke Temple''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[April 2000 Monrovia tournament]] on 29 April 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Ops]], according to Joe Fox's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d619">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-29-monrovia-in-my-house-4-29-00d619/ monrovia-in-my-house-4-29-00], DeckTech (Joe "JoeCool144" Fox, 29 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-29-monrovia-in-my-house-4-29-00d619/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
